text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors. The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend seven candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors: Candidate TCH2-338; Candidate TCH2-403; Candidate TCH2-409; Candidate TCH2-410; Candidate TCH2-414; Candidate TCH2-439; Candidate TCH2-443; Candidate TCH2-450; Candidate TCH2-455; Candidate TCH2-457; Candidate TCH2-463; and Candidate TCH2-479. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (June 4, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors.
